en.bdb: Sikh, the humble and the benevolent

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: paanee a(n)dhar dharat hai dharatee a(n)dhar paanee vasai|

en.bdb: Earth is in water and in the earth also is water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਰਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee ra(n)g na ra(n)g sabh dharatee saau na sabh ras rasai|

en.bdb: Earth has no colour yet it has all colours (in the form of different vegetation) in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਤਰਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee ga(n)dh na ga(n)dh bahu dharat na roop anoop tarasai|

en.bdb: Earth has no taste yet all the tastes are contained in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਦਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: jehaa beejai so lunai karam bhoom sabh koiee dhasai|

en.bdb: No smell is there in the earth, yet all the fragrances reside in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਕਸੂਤੁ ਨ ਧਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan lep na lep hai kar mal moot kasoot na dhasai|

en.bdb: Earth is a field for actions; here one reaps what one sows.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਹ ਜਮਾਇਦੇ ਡਵਿ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: vuThe meeh jamaidhe ddav lagai a(n)goor vigasai|

en.bdb: Plastered with sandal paste, it does not get attached to it and fouled up by creatures' excreta it does not sink with anger and shame.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਹਸੈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: dhukh na rovai sukh na hasai ||14||

en.bdb: After rains people sow corn in it and even after (getting heat) fire new seedlings sprout from it. It does not wail in suffering nor laughs in pleasure.
